scope: Agent visual/scenario review of the common Files frame; not a human usability study or final accessibility qualification
findings: Native Inter, shared icons and controls remain legible on ordinary, 150% and real 4K captures.
No essential navigation or empty-state text overlaps at the actual 500x420 size; Places replaces the sidebar.
Light and dark native/USB locations retain the same controls and bounded page footer.
Disconnected and empty folders retain the frame; long names use bounded display ellipsis while full supported addresses remain editable.

carry_forward.observation: Existing shared-menu helper footer uses bounded ellipsis; complete fitting remains planned.
Raw HiDPI captures suggest drawn cursor displacement. Isolate capture timing versus native cursor coordinates; scripted actions alone do not establish pointer usability.
